settings.title: Fit & Care
settings.content:
This is a pre-order. You order now, the run goes into production, and your size is cut with it and shipped to you first. Charged at checkout, which is what reserves the size. If the run is delayed beyond the date shown we write to you and you can cancel for a full refund.

Slim and tailored, with room drafted through the seat and thigh, then a clean taper from knee to ankle. A sharp line that holds all day.

If you train and sit between sizes, take the smaller waist. The stretch twill gives one to two centimetres within the first week of wear, so there is no need to size up for the leg.

Machine wash cold, hang to dry, no ironing.

settings.title: Details
settings.content:
Cotton twill blended with elastane, finished to resist wrinkles. A smooth face, natural drape, and a fabric that recovers instead of holding the knee you were sitting in.

Seams are reinforced at every stress point. Metal hardware rather than coated plastic. Two rear welt pockets, two slanted side pockets, and a hidden coin pocket at the waistband.

Designed in Brisbane. 97% cotton, 3% elastane.

settings.title: Shipping
settings.content:
Orders placed before 4pm dispatch from Brisbane the same afternoon.

  • Australia: 2 to 4 days. Free standard shipping over $100, free express over $200.
  • New Zealand: 2 to 4 days. Free priority express over NZ$160.

Tracked door to door on every order.
settings.content_intl:
Orders placed before 4pm dispatch from Brisbane the same afternoon.

  • Singapore: 4 to 6 days. Free standard shipping over S$250.
  • United Kingdom: 5 to 8 days. Free standard shipping over £65.
  • Europe: 6 to 9 days.

Every international order ships DDP. Duties and import taxes are calculated and paid at checkout, so nothing is owed on arrival.

settings.title: Exchanges & Returns
settings.content:
Free exchanges and returns within 44 days across Australia and New Zealand. Send it back in the satchel it arrived in, no questions asked.

Exchanges ship the day we scan your return, so a size swap does not cost you another week. Hemming does not affect your returns window.

settings.question: How do they fit?
settings.answer: Tailored through the seat and thigh with a 5 inch inseam that sits above the knee. If you are between sizes, size down. The stretch will accommodate.

settings.question: What is the fabric?
settings.answer: A lightweight stretch twill that breathes, recovers its shape and keeps a tailored line through the day.

settings.question: Are they comfortable for all day wear?
settings.answer: Yes. Built for long summer days, the stretch moves with you from the promenade to the table.

settings.question: What should I pair them with?
settings.answer: A polo and loafers for lunch. A linen shirt by the water. A tee and clean sneakers on the weekend.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer:
44 days to decide, starting the day it arrives. Exchanges and returns are free within Australia and New Zealand, returned in the satchel it came in.

Outside Australia and New Zealand you cover the return postage. Duties and taxes are included in every price, so nothing is owed on arrival.

settings.question: When will they arrive?
settings.answer:
This is a pre-order. The run ships in early November 2026, and pre-orders go out first, the same afternoon they are picked. You are charged at checkout, which is what reserves your size.

If the run is delayed beyond that date we write to you, and you can cancel for a full refund.
